# Where to find and how to farm for Gulpers in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 26, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: Sep 2, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a085c2c2ec014f4a9e5f01c88ece3c86~mv2.png)

Image Credit: __u/Previous-Act-8703__

__Used for__

**SCORE**

**Daily**

- Kill 3 Gulpers
- Take a Camera Picture of a Gupler while intoxicated by Mire Magic Moonshine
- Kill a Gulper while intoxicated by Mire Magic Moonshine
- Take a Camera Picture of a Gulper

**Weekly**

- Kill 10 Gulpers

**Pioneer Scout** 

- Tadpole: Herpetologist Badge 
 - Take a Camera Picture of a Gulper

**Lifetime Challenges**

- Take a Camera Picture of Glowing Gulper
- Take a Camera Picture of a Gulper
- Kill Aquatic Creatures 
 - Kill a Gulper

**Limited Time Challenges and Mini Season**

- Burning Love: Kill 10 Gulpers while on a Team using the Hot Rod Pink Flamer Skin
- Marshal Mallow's Marvelous Fishing Excursion: Kill 20 Gulpers with the Marshal Mallow Fishing Hat equipped

**Food Buffs**

- Gulper Slurry
- Gulper Stuffed Foot
- Pepperoni Roll

__X can drop the following items__

| **Item** | **Drop Chance** | 
| Gulper Innards | 100% | 
| Caps | 50% | 
| Large Junk | 50% | 
| Plan: Puncturing Pole Hook | 5%* | 

*Only drops if the player has not already learned the Plan: Pole Hook. Once learned, this plan stops dropping.

__Farming Tips and Tricks__

**The following perk cards, magazines, and/or backpack mods will increase your yields.**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5378e355d33745d1a2b036b37f446eb6~mv2.jpg)

__Vendors and Camp Allies__

**Berkeley Springs Train Station**

Check the poor robot vendor at Berkeley Springs Train Station — everyone dumps their innards there after the Moonshine Jamboree public event.

None

__Pip-Boy Dailys__

**Daily: Play Time**

Collect one piece each of Gulper Innards, Mirelurk Meat, and Angler Meat, then return them to Chloe.
